entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi Charlie... I'm calling because I'm just so disappointed. I ordered a jersey and it's not right at all.
Oh, I'm very sorry to hear that. I can definitely look into it for you. To start, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
It's the wrong size. I always get a medium, but this one is just way too tight. I can barely get it on. I've been a loyal customer for so long, and I saved up for this... it's just really upsetting.
I completely understand the frustration when a fit isn't right. It sounds like you'd like to do an exchange or return. Let me just check on that for you. Can I have your order number, please?
Yes, it's VF-8675309. I really hope you can help. I was counting on this for a big ride this weekend.

Thank you. Let me pull up that order... Okay, I see it here. It looks like the jersey was delivered about six days ago. According to our policy, you have 90 days for a return, so you're well within the timeframe.
Oh, that's such a relief! So I can send it back?

Absolutely. We can definitely process an exchange for a larger size, or a full refund if you'd prefer. I've just emailed a pre-paid return label to you. Simply pack the jersey back in its original packaging, apply the label, and drop it off.
An exchange would be perfect. You've really turned my day around, Charlie. Thank you so much.
I'm happy I could help. I've made a note on your account to ship out a size Large as soon as we receive the return tracking information. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thank you again!
You're very welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
